name: Tidewater Net
summary: A weighted fishing net that sinks fast and holds what it catches.
description: Coastal villages weave these nets from tarred cord and hang them from every doorway to dry.

stats.text: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Tidewater Net at a creature you can see within 10 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until it escapes.
